title: Timeout shorter than the device needs
summary: A reachable device answers too late for the configured timeout.

sections.heading: Recognize it
sections.body: Only timeouts, no exceptions; the device answers ping and other connections work. Gateways to serial devices are typically slower than direct TCP devices.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Compare the configured timeout with the documented response time and the observed round trip times.

modeled: Deterministic Modbus TCP client and servers: IPv4 subnet rules, address resolution, unit ID handling of gateways, function 03/04 reads, exceptions 01/02/0B, processing time against the configured timeout, INT and REAL values with word order
approximated: One request at a time per connection
omitted: Writes, other function codes and serial bus timing behind gateways
Byte order inside a register (words are big-endian as the protocol defines)

troubleshooting.effect: Replies arrive after the PLC gave up
repair: Configure a timeout above the response time
troubleshooting.explanation: The timeout must cover the slowest documented answer, with margin.
